items.exampleEn: Tears blurred her eyes as she read the letter.
items.exampleZh: 她讀信時，淚水模糊了雙眼。

items.exampleEn: The glare of the car's lights made it hard to see the road.
items.exampleZh: 車燈的強光讓人很難看清路面。

items.exampleEn: Sailors once used the stars to navigate at night.
items.exampleZh: 以前的水手在夜裡靠星星導航。

items.exampleEn: Winning the first game was a spur to train even harder.
items.exampleZh: 贏得第一場比賽成了更努力訓練的動力。

items.exampleEn: The nurse ushered the visitors out of the room.
items.exampleZh: 護理師把訪客帶出房間。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother cut old shirts into rags.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶把舊襯衫剪成一塊塊抹布。

items.exampleEn: This cleaner removes even old stains from carpets.
items.exampleZh: 這種清潔劑連地毯上的陳年汙漬都能去除。

items.exampleEn: The old soldier still has a proud bearing.
items.exampleZh: 那位老兵仍然保有自豪的舉止。

items.sentenceEn: The guide ushered the children into the museum.
items.sentenceZh: 導覽員帶孩子們走進博物館。

items.audioEn: The glare from the snow was so strong that we all had to wear sunglasses.
items.audioZh: 雪地的反光太刺眼，我們都得戴上太陽眼鏡。
items.questionZh: 他們為什麼要戴太陽眼鏡？
options: The white ground was too bright
It was very hot outside that day
They wanted to look cool in photos

items.sentenceEn: This map helps tourists navigate the narrow streets of the old town.
items.sentenceZh: 這張地圖幫助遊客在老城區的窄巷裡找路。

items.sentenceEn: The mud stained my new white shoes.
items.sentenceZh: 泥巴弄髒了我的新白鞋。

items.stemEn: I wiped the dirty window with an old ____.
items.stemZh: 我用一塊舊抹布擦那扇髒窗戶。

items.stemEn: Without my glasses, everything in the room starts to ____.
items.stemZh: 沒戴眼鏡時，房間裡的東西都開始變得模糊。

items.passageEn: Last month, I went to my cousin's wedding at an old hotel by the lake. At the door, a young man ushered us to our seats. The bride walked in with a calm, graceful bearing. When my uncle arrived late, his wife gave him an angry glare. During dinner, my little nephew spilled juice and left a big stain on the tablecloth, but a waiter quickly cleaned it with a rag. After the party, it was very dark, so we used our phones to navigate back to the car.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我去參加我表親在湖邊一間老飯店舉行的婚禮。在門口，一位年輕人帶我們入座。新娘以沉穩優雅的儀態走進來。我舅舅遲到時，舅媽狠狠瞪了他一眼。晚餐時，我的小姪子打翻果汁，在桌巾上留下一大片汙漬，不過服務生很快就用抹布擦乾淨了。派對結束後天色很暗，我們用手機導航走回停車的地方。

questions.questionZh: 舅舅遲到時，舅媽有什麼反應？
小姪子打翻果汁後怎麼了？
options: 大家拿著盤子換到別桌

items.promptZh: 雨水讓窗外的景色變得模糊。
referenceEn: The rain blurred the view from the window.
The view outside the window was blurred by the rain.
rubricZh: 要用 blur（例如 blurred the view）
句型例如主動句、被動句等都可以
時態合理即可（例如 blurred、was blurred）

items.promptZh: 這次的失敗反而激勵他重新開始寫作。
referenceEn: This failure actually spurred him to start writing again.
The failure spurred him on to begin writing again.
rubricZh: spur 當動詞「激勵」，常接人＋to＋動詞（例如 spurred him to start、spurred him on 等）
「重新開始寫作」可寫，例如 start writing again、begin to write again 等
時態用過去式或現在完成式都可以（例如 spurred、has spurred 等）
